title: Asher's first words to J: tune into my heart

tellings.quote: the first thing Asher said to J was like tune into my heart

plain: The very first thing someone named Asher said to a person called J was "tune into my heart." The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a documentary called The Telepathy Tapes about children said to read minds, relays this from those involved. It is told as an example of communication that seems to pass heart to heart rather than through ordinary speech.
